summary: A Harley Street skin clinic appears to lose bookings because the Book Online buttons and contact form do not appear to work.

findings.problem: Every Book Online button appears to point to an on page anchor that does not exist, so booking may not work.
findings.cost: Ready patients cannot book and leave.
findings.fix: Booking buttons that open a working booking page.

findings.problem: The contact form appears to be only an image with no visible fields.
findings.cost: Patients who want to write cannot.

findings.problem: Sunekos appears to show From TBC as its price, and the slider controls appear to read nexxt slide.
findings.cost: Placeholders and typos make the clinic look unfinished.

findings.problem: The Patient Reviews heading appears to show no reviews, hours appear as 10am to 5pm and also 9am to 5:30pm, and some claims appear unsourced.
findings.cost: Missing proof and conflicting hours reduce trust.
findings.fix: Real reviews and one set of hours.
